paite: Huan Aigupta gam ah Joseph apisuk ua; Pharaoh nuai a heutu khat, vengtu pawl heutu, Aigupta mi, Potiphar in ahon pisuk Ishmaelte khut a kipan aleita hi.
heading: Joseph Leh Potiphar Zi
english: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.

paite: Joseph kiang ah TOUPA a-om a, amah mi lohchingtak ahi a; apu Aigupta mi inn ah a-om hi.
english: Yahweh was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

paite: Apu in, TOUPA akiang ah a-om a, athilhih peuhmah TOUPA'N akhut ah alohchingsak chih athei hi.
english: His master saw that Yahweh was with him, and that Yahweh made all that he did prosper in his hand.

paite: Huchi in Joseph in apu mitmuh in deihsakna atang a, a-inn ah nna asem zel hi. Ama'n a-inkuante tung ah heutu in abawl a, aneih tengteng akhut ah akoih vek hi.
english: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and he made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, a-inn leh aneih tengteng tung a heutu ding a abawl nungsiah Joseph ziak in TOUPA'N Aigupta mi insung avualzawlta hi. Inn lam leh gam lam a aneih tengteng ah TOUPA'N avualzawl hi.
english: It happened from the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, that Yahweh blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; and the blessing of Yahweh was on all that he had, in the house and in the field.

paite: Huchi in aneih tengteng Joseph khut ah akoih a, aneih teng, a-an nek kia lou ngal bangmah atheihpih kei hi. Joseph pianhoih leh melhoihtak ahi.
english: He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand. He didn’t concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate. Joseph was well-built and handsome.

paite: Huai nung in hichi ahong hi a, apu zi in Joseph angaih et a, "Hon kithuahpih in," achi hi.
english: It happened after these things, that his master’s wife cast her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”

paite: Himahleh a-ut kei a, apu zi kiang ah, "Ka pu in hiai inn ah ka kiang ah bangbang a-om a chih lah athei ngal kei a, aneih tengteng ka khut ah akoih vek hi.
english: But he refused, and said to his master’s wife, “Behold, my master doesn’t know what is with me in the house, and he has put all that he has into my hand.

paite: Hiai insung ah kei sang a lianzaw kuamah a-om kei. Azi na hih ziak in nang kia lou ngal, kei a kipan bangmah it anei kei hi. Bangchi in hiai khelhna khawktak hih in Pathian tung ah thil ka hihkhial thei dia?" achi hi.
english: He isn’t greater in this house than I, neither has he kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, niteng in Joseph houpih zel mahleh amah kithuahpih lam thu hiam, ama kiang a om lam thu hiam alimsak nuam kei hi.
english: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

paite: Huchih lai in hichi ahong hi a, a-nna sem ding in insung ah ava lut a; insung ah mi himhim kuamah a-om kei hi.
english: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.

paite: Huchi in ama'n, "Hon kithuahpih in," chi in apuansilh ah ana man a, ama'n apuansilh akhut a nusia in ataikhia hi.
english: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, apuansilh akhut a nusia in ataikhia, chih atheihtak in,
english: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,

paite: A-inn a mite asam a, akiang uah, "En un, hon zahlaksak ding in Hebru mi khat i kiang ua hon pi ahita ve. Hon kithuahpih tum in ka kiang ah ahong lut a, huchi in ngaihtak in ka kikouta hi.
english: she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, “Behold, he has brought in a Hebrew to us to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.

paite: Huan hichi ahi a, aw suah a ngaihtak a ka kikou azaktak in hiai ka kiang ah apuansilh anusia a, ataikheta,” achi hi.
english: It happened, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

paite: Joseph pu ahong tun masiah apuansilh akiang ah ana koih gige hi.
english: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.

paite: Akiang ah hiai thu ana gen a, "Hebru sikha i kiang a na hon pi in hon zahlaksak tum in ka kiang ah ahong lut hi.
english: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me,

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, aw suah a ka kikoutak in hiai apuansilh ka kiang a nusia in ataikheta,” achi hi.
english: and it happened, as I lifted up my voice and cried, that he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

paite: Huan hichi ahi a, Joseph pu in azi in akiang a, "Na sikha in hichi in ahon bawl," chi a, athugen azak in, ahehna asou hi.
english: It happened, when his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, “This is what your servant did to me,” that his wrath was kindled.

paite: Huchi in Joseph pu in amah api a, suangkul, kumpi suangkul tangte khumna mun ah akhum a; huchi in suangkul ah a-omta hi.
english: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody.

paite: Himahleh Joseph kiang ah TOUPA a-om a, atung ah azahngai a, suangkul vengmi mitmuh in deihsakna atang hi.
english: But Yahweh was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

paite: Huchi in suangkul vengmi in suangkul a tang tengteng Joseph khut ah akemsakta hi. Huchi in huai a thil kihih peuhmah ama hih ahong hita.
english: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.

paite: Joseph kiang ah TOUPA a-om a, athilhih peuhmah TOUPA'N alohchinsak ziak in suangkul vengmi in akhut a thil om himhim a-enta kei hi.
english: The keeper of the prison didn’t look after anything that was under his hand, because Yahweh was with him; and that which he did, Yahweh made it prosper.
